# Brief

## Summary
The one artifact a design pipeline writes to before anything is built, at
`brief.gts`. Each stage owns one MarkdownField and never touches another's:
`spec` is what the thing is, `designDirection` is how it should look and
move, `motion` is the build numbers for an arc the direction asked for. A
stage replaces its own field whole, so nobody reads the whole brief back to
add a part, and nobody can truncate another stage's text by accident. Title
and summary live on `cardInfo`.

## API
- `spec` — MarkdownField; domain primer, schema, coverage matrix, per-screen content contracts, flows, sample data, open questions. Written by `domain-interview`
- `designDirection` — MarkdownField; style in full, the first screen in full, other screens as stubs, acceptance lines. Written by `design-direction`
- `motion` — MarkdownField; one motion system, engine per beat, load-bearing structure, exhaustive effect table, the three capture points. Written by `motion-authoring`, only when the direction recorded an arc
- `cardInfo.name` / `cardInfo.summary` — the title and the overview paragraph

## Usage
```json
{ "meta": { "adoptsFrom": { "module": "@cardstack/catalog/cards/projects/brief", "name": "Brief" } } }
```
Instances live at `Brief/<slug>.json` in the realm being built for. Fill a
field with `patch-fields` once the card has indexed; change one block inside
a field with `apply-markdown-edit`, not a resend of the field.

## Non-goals
Scores and review verdicts — `design-review` reads this card and writes
nothing. Build state, task lists and theme tokens belong to whatever builds
from the brief, not on it.
